issues.explanation: In this construction, 之后 means “descendant(s),” while the preceding lineage phrase supplies the “of” relationship.
Here 身长 is predicative and describes Liu Bei’s stature, not the noun “height.”
In 听见后, 后 is a temporal noun/word meaning “after,” rather than a grammatical particle.
The standard pinyin for 一千 is yī qiān; the displayed yì reflects a tone-sandhi pronunciation rather than the usual dictionary form.
After 五百, 多 means “more than,” not “about,” in this context.
